top_choice_rationale: The Rees and Einsle crystal structures of the nitrogenase MoFe protein and FeMo-cofactor, including the central carbide, are determined, independently confirmed over three decades and underpin all later spectroscopic and computational work on dinitrogen activation. A structure-only citation with two names is clean in attribution and fits the three-laureate limit, while leaving the unresolved catalytic cycle out of the claim. Dean, Seefeldt and Ribbe fall outside it, which the expert reports must justify.
recusal_note: No candidate-specific conflict apparent from profile. My research on respiratory-chain proton and electron transfer is adjacent to B064 and B060, and I am a Stockholm University colleague of Xiaodong Zou, who also supports nitrogenase.
